summary: Prepare strict internal decoding of incoming agent review answers

replay.detail: No append path or answer fold calls the decoder.

schema.detail: No accepted wire changes; generic append and both public gate parsers remain closed to agent-review.

rules.detail: The dormant decoder reads all candidate bindings, reason and evidence from ClaimInput only. It rejects missing, malformed and unknown fields, absent actor, mismatched operation and missing envelope request evidence; person delegation fields are not accepted.

compatibility.detail: Typed decoded candidates use the existing request-aware predicate. No production caller or API exposure is enabled.

recovery.detail: No data migration or recovery is required.
